name: Mercosur

flag.description: A white field with four blue four-pointed stars of the Southern Cross above a curved green line, and the name MERCOSUR in blue letters below.
flag.symbolism: The Southern Cross marks the bloc's place in the Southern Hemisphere, above a green arc of the horizon.

hook: Mercosur is mostly white: four blue Southern Cross stars over a green horizon, with the name spelled out underneath in case you forget.
trivia: Mercosur was founded by the Treaty of Asunción in 1991, signed by Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.
The flag has a Portuguese version that reads MERCOSUL instead of MERCOSUR.
